title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 1)
description_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 1), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: The opening lecture in a sub-series examining anthropomorphic doctrines associated with Ibn Taymiyya and his followers.
